failureTreatment: Count every started job in the denominator; retain failures after repair.
tieTreatment: Report ties as ties; do not convert them to wins.
unsupportedInputTreatment: Block and record unsupported inputs; do not score them as successful outputs.
statisticalAnalysis: Account for repeated runs within briefs and multiple ratings of the same book; report uncertainty for the primary outcome.
stoppingRule: Run every preregistered benchmark job with no optional stopping for observed performance; stop only for a mandatory safety/access-control/data-preservation failure or before the approved spending ceiling would be exceeded.
